data.name: Naval Tactics
data.detailed_description:
Naval Tactics is a Naval Real-Time Strategy, focusing on the first half of the 20th century. Play solo, or against other players in multiplayer.

➤ Historical Inspirations

Inspired by the events of the Pacific Theater during World War 2, Naval Tactics recreates various challenges faced by commanders back in the day, allowing you to choose your own path to victory.

➤ Vehicles

Naval Tactics offers over 110 replicas of vehicles of various types, including ships, submarines, planes, and tanks, providing you a great variety in ways to approach any situation. 

➤ Game modes

  • Skirmish - Play on smaller maps. Choose your side and fleet at the start of the match, capture objectives and sink enemy ships to gain points.

  • Operations - Capture, defend, and upgrade bases across the Pacific Ocean, from the shores of Hawaii, to the Philippine Sea and beyond. Upgrade and maintain your forces through an expansive tech tree. Your ships and bases require resources to function, so make sure to keep them resupplied!

➤ Features

  • Variety of Skirmish maps inspired by historical battles.

  • Over 110 different vehicles.

  • Real Time gameplay with the ability to slow and speed up time.

  • Change camera angle, temperature, and choose between dark and light mode to suit your preferences.

data.short_description: Naval Tactics is a Stylized, Top-Down RTS focusing on naval combat in the first half of the 20th century. Play against other players in Multiplayer, or get aboard your flagship by yourself in Singleplayer.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 2500 or similar.
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050, AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A GPU with Direct X 12 support is strongly recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 7600, Intel i5-13400
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 4060, AMD RX 7600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended.
